diff --git a/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts b/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e0da6ff0e5583bf27e2298241fa7a266d085feb6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,165 @@
+import { expect, test, type Page, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+const TERRARIUM = '[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]';
+const ACTIVATION_NAME = 'Spustit minihru s krajtou';
+const SCENARIOS = [
+    { name: 'desktop-1', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'desktop-1.25', width: 1279, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1.25, activation: 'Enter' },
+    { name: 'desktop-2', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'Space' },
+    { name: 'desktop-3', width: 1280, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'mobile-1', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-2', width: 390, height: 900, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-3', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'small-mobile-3', width: 320, height: 800, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+] as const;
+
+async function preparePage(page: Page) {
+    await page.goto('/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+    await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+    // Freeze after hydration, so installing the controlled clock cannot prevent React from attaching activation.
+    await page.waitForFunction((selector) => {
+        const button = document.querySelector(`${selector} button`);
+        return button !== null && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+    await page.clock.install();
+    await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+    await page.addStyleTag({ content: `${TERRARIUM} output { visibility: hidden !important; }` });
+    await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+        const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+        (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark = mark;
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+}
+
+async function measureDifference(first: Buffer, second: Buffer) {
+    const reference = await sharp(first).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    const candidate = await sharp(second).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    expect(candidate.info).toEqual(reference.info);
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(reference.data.length);
+    let changedPixels = 0;
+    let maximumDifference = 0;
+    let differenceSum = 0;
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(reference.data[offset + channel] - candidate.data[offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            differenceSum += value;
+            difference[offset + channel] = Math.min(255, value * 12);
+        }
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+        if (pixelDifference > 0) changedPixels++;
+        maximumDifference = Math.max(maximumDifference, pixelDifference);
+    }
+    return {
+        changedPixels,
+        maximumDifference,
+        meanDifference: differenceSum / reference.data.length,
+        image: await sharp(difference, { raw: reference.info }).png().toBuffer(),
+        overlay: await sharp(first).composite([{ input: await sharp(second).ensureAlpha(0.5).png().toBuffer() }]).png().toBuffer(),
+    };
+}
+
+async function saveImage(testInfo: TestInfo, name: string, data: Buffer) {
+    await writeFile(testInfo.outputPath(name), data);
+    await testInfo.attach(name, { body: data, contentType: 'image/png' });
+}
+
+for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) {
+    test.describe(scenario.name, () => {
+        test.use({
+            viewport: { width: scenario.width, height: scenario.height },
+            deviceScaleFactor: scenario.pixelRatio,
+            hasTouch: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+            isMobile: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+        });
+
+        test('the original logo starts moving without a replacement shape', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
+            await preparePage(page);
+            const clip = (await page.locator(TERRARIUM).boundingBox())!;
+            const initialMarkup = await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML();
+            const frames: { name: string; image: Buffer }[] = [];
+            const capture = async (name: string) => {
+                const image = await page.screenshot({ clip });
+                frames.push({ name, image });
+                await saveImage(testInfo, `${name}.png`, image);
+                return image;
+            };
+            const staticFrame = await capture('00-static');
+            const button = page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME });
+            if (scenario.activation === 'touch') await button.tap();
+            else if (scenario.activation === 'click') await button.click();
+            else await button.press(scenario.activation);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+            await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+            const firstFrame = await capture('01-first-game');
+            const difference = await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstFrame);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-difference-12x.png', difference.image);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-overlay.png', difference.overlay);
+            expect(difference.changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).toBe(initialMarkup);
+
+            await page.clock.runFor(16);
+            const firstAnimationFrame = await capture('02-first-animation');
+            expect((await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstAnimationFrame)).changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            let elapsed = 0;
+            for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 188, 200, 600]) {
+                await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+                elapsed += duration;
+                await capture(`release-${String(elapsed).padStart(4, '0')}ms`);
+                expect(await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+                    const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+                    return mark === (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark &&
+                        getComputedStyle(mark).opacity === '1' && mark.querySelectorAll('path').length === 3;
+                }, TERRARIUM)).toBe(true);
+            }
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).not.toBe(initialMarkup);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} output`)).toContainText('Skóre:');
+
+            const contactSheet = await sharp({ create: { width: 280 * 4, height: 306 * 3, channels: 4, background: '#232a25' } })
+                .composite(await Promise.all(frames.map(async (frame, index) => ({
+                    input: await sharp(frame.image).resize(280, 280).extend({ bottom: 26, background: '#232a25' })
+                        .composite([{ input: Buffer.from(`<svg width="280" height="26"><text x="8" y="18" fill="white" font-size="13">${frame.name}</text></svg>`), top: 280, left: 0 }]).png().toBuffer(),
+                    left: (index % 4) * 280, top: Math.floor(index / 4) * 306,
+                }))))
+                .png().toBuffer();
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'release-contact-sheet.png', contactSheet);
+            const archive = path.resolve('.tmp/snake-handoff/verified', scenario.name);
+            await mkdir(archive, { recursive: true });
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'release-contact-sheet.png'), contactSheet);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'handoff-difference-12x.png'), difference.image);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'metrics.json'), JSON.stringify({
+                scenario, changedPixels: difference.changedPixels, maximumDifference: difference.maximumDifference,
+                meanDifference: difference.meanDifference, elapsed,
+            }, null, 2));
+        });
+    });
+}
+
+test('resize and another visit retain the logo and running path', async ({ page }) => {
+    for (let visit = 0; visit < 2; visit++) {
+        await preparePage(page);
+        const mark = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`);
+        const originalPaths = await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')));
+        await page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME }).click();
+        await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 391, height: 900 });
+        await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).toEqual(originalPaths);
+        await page.clock.runFor(48);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).not.toEqual(originalPaths);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.clock.runFor(32);
+        const canvas = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`);
+        const dimensions = await canvas.evaluate((element: HTMLCanvasElement) => ({
+            width: element.width, expectedWidth: Math.round(element.getBoundingClientRect().width * devicePixelRatio),
+        }));
+        expect(dimensions.width).toBe(dimensions.expectedWidth);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.every((element) => !/NaN|Infinity/.test(element.getAttribute('d') ?? '')))).toBe(true);
+        await page.clock.resume();
+    }
+});

+import { chromium } from 'playwright';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+const DIRECTORY = '.tmp/snake-handoff/after';
+await mkdir(DIRECTORY, { recursive: true });
+const browser = await chromium.launch();
+const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
+page.on('pageerror', (error) => console.log(error.message));
+await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4010/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 180000 });
+const terrarium = page.locator('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]');
+await terrarium.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+await page.waitForFunction(() => {
+  const button = document.querySelector('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium] button');
+  return button && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+}, { timeout: 120000 });
+await page.clock.install();
+await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+const frame = await terrarium.boundingBox();
+await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/static.png`, clip: frame });
+await writeFile(`${DIRECTORY}/geometry.json`, JSON.stringify(await page.evaluate(() => {
+  const container = document.querySelector('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]');
+  const mark = container.querySelector('svg');
+  return { container: container.getBoundingClientRect(), mark: mark.getBoundingClientRect(), pixelRatio: devicePixelRatio };
+}), null, 2));
+await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Spustit minihru s krajtou' }).click();
+await page.locator('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium] canvas').waitFor();
+await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+await page.clock.runFor(17);
+await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/first.png`, clip: frame });
+for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 67, 100, 150, 200, 200, 300, 600, 1000]) {
+  await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+  await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/frame-${await page.evaluate(() => performance.now())}.png`, clip: frame });
+}
+await browser.close();

+import { AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY, AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaMarkArtwork';
+import { createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaSnakeBody';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+async function main() {
+    const directory = '.tmp/snake-handoff/geometry';
+    await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
+    const shapes = createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY);
+    const pictures: Buffer[] = [];
+    for (const isCanonical of [true, false]) {
+        const markup = AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES.map((shape, index) => {
+            const gradient = shape.gradient;
+            const start = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x1, y: gradient.y1 } : shapes[index].gradientStart;
+            const end = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x2, y: gradient.y2 } : shapes[index].gradientEnd;
+            return `<defs><linearGradient id="${shape.id}" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="${start.x}" y1="${start.y}" x2="${end.x}" y2="${end.y}">${gradient.stops.map((stop) => `<stop offset="${stop.offset}" stop-color="${stop.color}"/>`).join('')}</linearGradient></defs><path d="${isCanonical ? shape.pathData : shapes[index].pathData}" fill="url(#${shape.id})"/>`;
+        }).join('');
+        const svg = Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 128 128" width="768" height="768"><rect width="128" height="128" fill="#232a25"/>${markup}</svg>`);
+        await sharp(svg).png().toFile(`${directory}/${isCanonical ? 'canonical' : 'deformed'}.png`);
+        pictures.push(await sharp(svg).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer());
+    }
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(pictures[0].length);
+    let maximum = 0;
+    let sum = 0;
+    const bounds = [Infinity, Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(pictures[0][offset + channel] - pictures[1][offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            maximum = Math.max(maximum, value);
+            sum += value;
+        }
+        if (pixelDifference > 2) {
+            const x = (offset / 4) % 768;
+            const y = Math.floor(offset / 4 / 768);
+            bounds[0] = Math.min(bounds[0], x); bounds[1] = Math.min(bounds[1], y);

+        }
+        difference[offset] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 1] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 2] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+    }
+    await sharp(difference, { raw: { width: 768, height: 768, channels: 4 } }).png().toFile(`${directory}/difference.png`);
+    console.log({ maximum, mean: sum / difference.length, bounds });
+}
+main();

diff --git a/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts b/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e0da6ff0e5583bf27e2298241fa7a266d085feb6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,165 @@
+import { expect, test, type Page, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+const TERRARIUM = '[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]';
+const ACTIVATION_NAME = 'Spustit minihru s krajtou';
+const SCENARIOS = [
+    { name: 'desktop-1', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'desktop-1.25', width: 1279, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1.25, activation: 'Enter' },
+    { name: 'desktop-2', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'Space' },
+    { name: 'desktop-3', width: 1280, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'mobile-1', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-2', width: 390, height: 900, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-3', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'small-mobile-3', width: 320, height: 800, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+] as const;
+
+async function preparePage(page: Page) {
+    await page.goto('/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+    await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+    // Freeze after hydration, so installing the controlled clock cannot prevent React from attaching activation.
+    await page.waitForFunction((selector) => {
+        const button = document.querySelector(`${selector} button`);
+        return button !== null && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+    await page.clock.install();
+    await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+    await page.addStyleTag({ content: `${TERRARIUM} output { visibility: hidden !important; }` });
+    await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+        const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+        (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark = mark;
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+}
+
+async function measureDifference(first: Buffer, second: Buffer) {
+    const reference = await sharp(first).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    const candidate = await sharp(second).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    expect(candidate.info).toEqual(reference.info);
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(reference.data.length);
+    let changedPixels = 0;
+    let maximumDifference = 0;
+    let differenceSum = 0;
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(reference.data[offset + channel] - candidate.data[offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            differenceSum += value;
+            difference[offset + channel] = Math.min(255, value * 12);
+        }
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+        if (pixelDifference > 0) changedPixels++;
+        maximumDifference = Math.max(maximumDifference, pixelDifference);
+    }
+    return {
+        changedPixels,
+        maximumDifference,
+        meanDifference: differenceSum / reference.data.length,
+        image: await sharp(difference, { raw: reference.info }).png().toBuffer(),
+        overlay: await sharp(first).composite([{ input: await sharp(second).ensureAlpha(0.5).png().toBuffer() }]).png().toBuffer(),
+    };
+}
+
+async function saveImage(testInfo: TestInfo, name: string, data: Buffer) {
+    await writeFile(testInfo.outputPath(name), data);
+    await testInfo.attach(name, { body: data, contentType: 'image/png' });
+}
+
+for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) {
+    test.describe(scenario.name, () => {
+        test.use({
+            viewport: { width: scenario.width, height: scenario.height },
+            deviceScaleFactor: scenario.pixelRatio,
+            hasTouch: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+            isMobile: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+        });
+
+        test('the original logo starts moving without a replacement shape', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
+            await preparePage(page);
+            const clip = (await page.locator(TERRARIUM).boundingBox())!;
+            const initialMarkup = await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML();
+            const frames: { name: string; image: Buffer }[] = [];
+            const capture = async (name: string) => {
+                const image = await page.screenshot({ clip });
+                frames.push({ name, image });
+                await saveImage(testInfo, `${name}.png`, image);
+                return image;
+            };
+            const staticFrame = await capture('00-static');

+import { AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY, AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaMarkArtwork';
+import { createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaSnakeBody';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+async function main() {
+    const directory = '.tmp/snake-handoff/geometry';
+    await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
+    const shapes = createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY);
+    const pictures: Buffer[] = [];
+    for (const isCanonical of [true, false]) {
+        const markup = AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES.map((shape, index) => {
+            const gradient = shape.gradient;
+            const start = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x1, y: gradient.y1 } : shapes[index].gradientStart;
+            const end = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x2, y: gradient.y2 } : shapes[index].gradientEnd;
+            return `<defs><linearGradient id="${shape.id}" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="${start.x}" y1="${start.y}" x2="${end.x}" y2="${end.y}">${gradient.stops.map((stop) => `<stop offset="${stop.offset}" stop-color="${stop.color}"/>`).join('')}</linearGradient></defs><path d="${isCanonical ? shape.pathData : shapes[index].pathData}" fill="url(#${shape.id})"/>`;
+        }).join('');
+        const svg = Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 128 128" width="768" height="768"><rect width="128" height="128" fill="#232a25"/>${markup}</svg>`);
+        await sharp(svg).png().toFile(`${directory}/${isCanonical ? 'canonical' : 'deformed'}.png`);
+        pictures.push(await sharp(svg).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer());
+    }
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(pictures[0].length);
+    let maximum = 0;
+    let sum = 0;
+    const bounds = [Infinity, Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(pictures[0][offset + channel] - pictures[1][offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            maximum = Math.max(maximum, value);
+            sum += value;
+        }
+        if (pixelDifference > 2) {
+            const x = (offset / 4) % 768;
+            const y = Math.floor(offset / 4 / 768);
+            bounds[0] = Math.min(bounds[0], x); bounds[1] = Math.min(bounds[1], y);
+            bounds[2] = Math.max(bounds[2], x); bounds[3] = Math.max(bounds[3], y);
+        }
+        difference[offset] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 1] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 2] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+    }
+    await sharp(difference, { raw: { width: 768, height: 768, channels: 4 } }).png().toFile(`${directory}/difference.png`);
+    console.log({ maximum, mean: sum / difference.length, bounds });
+}
+main();

diff --git a/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts b/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts
new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,165 @@
+import { expect, test, type Page, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+const TERRARIUM = '[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]';
+const ACTIVATION_NAME = 'Spustit minihru s krajtou';
+const SCENARIOS = [
+    { name: 'desktop-1', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'desktop-1.25', width: 1279, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1.25, activation: 'Enter' },
+    { name: 'desktop-2', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'Space' },
+    { name: 'desktop-3', width: 1280, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'mobile-1', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-2', width: 390, height: 900, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-3', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'small-mobile-3', width: 320, height: 800, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+] as const;
+
+async function preparePage(page: Page) {
+    await page.goto('/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+    await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+    // Freeze after hydration, so installing the controlled clock cannot prevent React from attaching activation.
+    await page.waitForFunction((selector) => {
+        const button = document.querySelector(`${selector} button`);
+        return button !== null && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+    await page.clock.install();
+    await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+    await page.addStyleTag({ content: `${TERRARIUM} output { visibility: hidden !important; }` });
+    await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+        const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+        (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark = mark;
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+}
+
+async function measureDifference(first: Buffer, second: Buffer) {
+    const reference = await sharp(first).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    const candidate = await sharp(second).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    expect(candidate.info).toEqual(reference.info);
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(reference.data.length);
+    let changedPixels = 0;
+    let maximumDifference = 0;
+    let differenceSum = 0;
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(reference.data[offset + channel] - candidate.data[offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            differenceSum += value;
+            difference[offset + channel] = Math.min(255, value * 12);
+        }
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+        if (pixelDifference > 0) changedPixels++;
+        maximumDifference = Math.max(maximumDifference, pixelDifference);
+    }
+    return {
+        changedPixels,
+        maximumDifference,
+        meanDifference: differenceSum / reference.data.length,
+        image: await sharp(difference, { raw: reference.info }).png().toBuffer(),
+        overlay: await sharp(first).composite([{ input: await sharp(second).ensureAlpha(0.5).png().toBuffer() }]).png().toBuffer(),
+    };
+}
+
+async function saveImage(testInfo: TestInfo, name: string, data: Buffer) {
+    await writeFile(testInfo.outputPath(name), data);
+    await testInfo.attach(name, { body: data, contentType: 'image/png' });
+}
+
+for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) {
+    test.describe(scenario.name, () => {
+        test.use({
+            viewport: { width: scenario.width, height: scenario.height },
+            deviceScaleFactor: scenario.pixelRatio,
+            hasTouch: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+            isMobile: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+        });
+
+        test('the original logo starts moving without a replacement shape', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
+            await preparePage(page);
+            const clip = (await page.locator(TERRARIUM).boundingBox())!;
+            const initialMarkup = await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML();
+            const frames: { name: string; image: Buffer }[] = [];
+            const capture = async (name: string) => {
+                const image = await page.screenshot({ clip });
+                frames.push({ name, image });
+                await saveImage(testInfo, `${name}.png`, image);
+                return image;
+            };
+            const staticFrame = await capture('00-static');
+            const button = page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME });
+            if (scenario.activation === 'touch') await button.tap();
+            else if (scenario.activation === 'click') await button.click();
+            else await button.press(scenario.activation);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+            await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+            const firstFrame = await capture('01-first-game');
+            const difference = await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstFrame);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-difference-12x.png', difference.image);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-overlay.png', difference.overlay);
+            expect(difference.changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).toBe(initialMarkup);
+
+            await page.clock.runFor(16);
+            const firstAnimationFrame = await capture('02-first-animation');
+            expect((await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstAnimationFrame)).changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            let elapsed = 0;
+            for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 188, 200, 600]) {
+                await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+                elapsed += duration;
+                await capture(`release-${String(elapsed).padStart(4, '0')}ms`);
+                expect(await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+                    const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+                    return mark === (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark &&
+                        getComputedStyle(mark).opacity === '1' && mark.querySelectorAll('path').length === 3;
+                }, TERRARIUM)).toBe(true);
+            }
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).not.toBe(initialMarkup);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} output`)).toContainText('Skóre:');
+
+            const contactSheet = await sharp({ create: { width: 280 * 4, height: 306 * 3, channels: 4, background: '#232a25' } })
+                .composite(await Promise.all(frames.map(async (frame, index) => ({
+                    input: await sharp(frame.image).resize(280, 280).extend({ bottom: 26, background: '#232a25' })
+                        .composite([{ input: Buffer.from(`<svg width="280" height="26"><text x="8" y="18" fill="white" font-size="13">${frame.name}</text></svg>`), top: 280, left: 0 }]).png().toBuffer(),
+                    left: (index % 4) * 280, top: Math.floor(index / 4) * 306,
+                }))))
+                .png().toBuffer();
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'release-contact-sheet.png', contactSheet);
+            const archive = path.resolve('.tmp/snake-handoff/verified', scenario.name);
+            await mkdir(archive, { recursive: true });
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'release-contact-sheet.png'), contactSheet);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'handoff-difference-12x.png'), difference.image);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'metrics.json'), JSON.stringify({
+                scenario, changedPixels: difference.changedPixels, maximumDifference: difference.maximumDifference,
+                meanDifference: difference.meanDifference, elapsed,
+            }, null, 2));
+        });
+    });
+}
+
+test('resize and another visit retain the logo and running path', async ({ page }) => {
+    for (let visit = 0; visit < 2; visit++) {
+        await preparePage(page);
+        const mark = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`);
+        const originalPaths = await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')));
+        await page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME }).click();
+        await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 391, height: 900 });
+        await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).toEqual(originalPaths);
+        await page.clock.runFor(48);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).not.toEqual(originalPaths);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.clock.runFor(32);
+        const canvas = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`);
+        const dimensions = await canvas.evaluate((element: HTMLCanvasElement) => ({
+            width: element.width, expectedWidth: Math.round(element.getBoundingClientRect().width * devicePixelRatio),
+        }));
+        expect(dimensions.width).toBe(dimensions.expectedWidth);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.every((element) => !/NaN|Infinity/.test(element.getAttribute('d') ?? '')))).toBe(true);
+        await page.clock.resume();
+    }
+});

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..0290e2bcb51472e2279b3d707a319e0d4471ceeb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/capture-snake-before.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { chromium } from 'playwright';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+const DIRECTORY = '.tmp/snake-handoff/after';
+await mkdir(DIRECTORY, { recursive: true });
+const browser = await chromium.launch();
+const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
+page.on('pageerror', (error) => console.log(error.message));
+await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4010/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 180000 });
+const terrarium = page.locator('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]');
+await terrarium.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+await page.waitForFunction(() => {
+  const button = document.querySelector('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium] button');
+  return button && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+}, { timeout: 120000 });
+await page.clock.install();
+await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+const frame = await terrarium.boundingBox();
+await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/static.png`, clip: frame });
+await writeFile(`${DIRECTORY}/geometry.json`, JSON.stringify(await page.evaluate(() => {
+  const container = document.querySelector('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]');
+  const mark = container.querySelector('svg');
+  return { container: container.getBoundingClientRect(), mark: mark.getBoundingClientRect(), pixelRatio: devicePixelRatio };
+}), null, 2));
+await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Spustit minihru s krajtou' }).click();
+await page.locator('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium] canvas').waitFor();
+await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+await page.clock.runFor(17);
+await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/first.png`, clip: frame });
+for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 67, 100, 150, 200, 200, 300, 600, 1000]) {
+  await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+  await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/frame-${await page.evaluate(() => performance.now())}.png`, clip: frame });
+}
+await browser.close();
diff --git a/.tmp/inspect-snake-art.ts b/.tmp/inspect-snake-art.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4a5f3f624bd0e8b0045de75e3146656af4d216a1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/inspect-snake-art.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import { AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY, AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaMarkArtwork';
+import { createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaSnakeBody';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+async function main() {
+    const directory = '.tmp/snake-handoff/geometry';
+    await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
+    const shapes = createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY);
+    const pictures: Buffer[] = [];
+    for (const isCanonical of [true, false]) {
+        const markup = AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES.map((shape, index) => {
+            const gradient = shape.gradient;
+            const start = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x1, y: gradient.y1 } : shapes[index].gradientStart;
+            const end = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x2, y: gradient.y2 } : shapes[index].gradientEnd;
+            return `<defs><linearGradient id="${shape.id}" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="${start.x}" y1="${start.y}" x2="${end.x}" y2="${end.y}">${gradient.stops.map((stop) => `<stop offset="${stop.offset}" stop-color="${stop.color}"/>`).join('')}</linearGradient></defs><path d="${isCanonical ? shape.pathData : shapes[index].pathData}" fill="url(#${shape.id})"/>`;
+        }).join('');
+        const svg = Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 128 128" width="768" height="768"><rect width="128" height="128" fill="#232a25"/>${markup}</svg>`);
+        await sharp(svg).png().toFile(`${directory}/${isCanonical ? 'canonical' : 'deformed'}.png`);
+        pictures.push(await sharp(svg).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer());
+    }
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(pictures[0].length);
+    let maximum = 0;
+    let sum = 0;
+    const bounds = [Infinity, Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(pictures[0][offset + channel] - pictures[1][offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            maximum = Math.max(maximum, value);
+            sum += value;
+        }
+        if (pixelDifference > 2) {
+            const x = (offset / 4) % 768;
+            const y = Math.floor(offset / 4 / 768);
+            bounds[0] = Math.min(bounds[0], x); bounds[1] = Math.min(bounds[1], y);
+            bounds[2] = Math.max(bounds[2], x); bounds[3] = Math.max(bounds[3], y);
+        }
+        difference[offset] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 1] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 2] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+    }
+    await sharp(difference, { raw: { width: 768, height: 768, channels: 4 } }).png().toFile(`${directory}/difference.png`);
+    console.log({ maximum, mean: sum / difference.length, bounds });
+}
+main();

diff --git a/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts b/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e0da6ff0e5583bf27e2298241fa7a266d085feb6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/ai-ta-krajta-snake.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,165 @@
+import { expect, test, type Page, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+const TERRARIUM = '[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]';
+const ACTIVATION_NAME = 'Spustit minihru s krajtou';
+const SCENARIOS = [
+    { name: 'desktop-1', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'desktop-1.25', width: 1279, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1.25, activation: 'Enter' },
+    { name: 'desktop-2', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'Space' },
+    { name: 'desktop-3', width: 1280, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'mobile-1', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-2', width: 390, height: 900, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-3', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'small-mobile-3', width: 320, height: 800, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+] as const;
+
+async function preparePage(page: Page) {
+    await page.goto('/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+    await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+    // Freeze after hydration, so installing the controlled clock cannot prevent React from attaching activation.
+    await page.waitForFunction((selector) => {
+        const button = document.querySelector(`${selector} button`);
+        return button !== null && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+    await page.clock.install();
+    await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+    await page.addStyleTag({ content: `${TERRARIUM} output { visibility: hidden !important; }` });
+    await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+        const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+        (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark = mark;
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+}
+
+async function measureDifference(first: Buffer, second: Buffer) {
+    const reference = await sharp(first).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    const candidate = await sharp(second).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    expect(candidate.info).toEqual(reference.info);
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(reference.data.length);
+    let changedPixels = 0;
+    let maximumDifference = 0;
+    let differenceSum = 0;
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(reference.data[offset + channel] - candidate.data[offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            differenceSum += value;
+            difference[offset + channel] = Math.min(255, value * 12);
+        }
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+        if (pixelDifference > 0) changedPixels++;
+        maximumDifference = Math.max(maximumDifference, pixelDifference);
+    }
+    return {
+        changedPixels,
+        maximumDifference,
+        meanDifference: differenceSum / reference.data.length,
+        image: await sharp(difference, { raw: reference.info }).png().toBuffer(),
+        overlay: await sharp(first).composite([{ input: await sharp(second).ensureAlpha(0.5).png().toBuffer() }]).png().toBuffer(),
+    };
+}
+
+async function saveImage(testInfo: TestInfo, name: string, data: Buffer) {
+    await writeFile(testInfo.outputPath(name), data);
+    await testInfo.attach(name, { body: data, contentType: 'image/png' });
+}
+
+for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) {
+    test.describe(scenario.name, () => {
+        test.use({
+            viewport: { width: scenario.width, height: scenario.height },
+            deviceScaleFactor: scenario.pixelRatio,
+            hasTouch: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+            isMobile: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+        });
+
+        test('the original logo starts moving without a replacement shape', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
+            await preparePage(page);
+            const clip = (await page.locator(TERRARIUM).boundingBox())!;
+            const initialMarkup = await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML();
+            const frames: { name: string; image: Buffer }[] = [];
+            const capture = async (name: string) => {
+                const image = await page.screenshot({ clip });
+                frames.push({ name, image });
+                await saveImage(testInfo, `${name}.png`, image);
+                return image;
+            };
+            const staticFrame = await capture('00-static');
+            const button = page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME });
+            if (scenario.activation === 'touch') await button.tap();
+            else if (scenario.activation === 'click') await button.click();
+            else await button.press(scenario.activation);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+            await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+            const firstFrame = await capture('01-first-game');
+            const difference = await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstFrame);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-difference-12x.png', difference.image);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-overlay.png', difference.overlay);
+            expect(difference.changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).toBe(initialMarkup);
+
+            await page.clock.runFor(16);
+            const firstAnimationFrame = await capture('02-first-animation');
+            expect((await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstAnimationFrame)).changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            let elapsed = 0;
+            for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 188, 200, 600]) {
+                await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+                elapsed += duration;
+                await capture(`release-${String(elapsed).padStart(4, '0')}ms`);
+                expect(await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+                    const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+                    return mark === (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark &&
+                        getComputedStyle(mark).opacity === '1' && mark.querySelectorAll('path').length === 3;
+                }, TERRARIUM)).toBe(true);
+            }
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).not.toBe(initialMarkup);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} output`)).toContainText('Skóre:');
+
+            const contactSheet = await sharp({ create: { width: 280 * 4, height: 306 * 3, channels: 4, background: '#232a25' } })
+                .composite(await Promise.all(frames.map(async (frame, index) => ({
+                    input: await sharp(frame.image).resize(280, 280).extend({ bottom: 26, background: '#232a25' })
+                        .composite([{ input: Buffer.from(`<svg width="280" height="26"><text x="8" y="18" fill="white" font-size="13">${frame.name}</text></svg>`), top: 280, left: 0 }]).png().toBuffer(),
+                    left: (index % 4) * 280, top: Math.floor(index / 4) * 306,
+                }))))
+                .png().toBuffer();
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'release-contact-sheet.png', contactSheet);
+            const archive = path.resolve('.tmp/snake-handoff/verified', scenario.name);
+            await mkdir(archive, { recursive: true });
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'release-contact-sheet.png'), contactSheet);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'handoff-difference-12x.png'), difference.image);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'metrics.json'), JSON.stringify({
+                scenario, changedPixels: difference.changedPixels, maximumDifference: difference.maximumDifference,
+                meanDifference: difference.meanDifference, elapsed,
+            }, null, 2));
+        });
+    });
+}
+
+test('resize and another visit retain the logo and running path', async ({ page }) => {
+    for (let visit = 0; visit < 2; visit++) {
+        await preparePage(page);
+        const mark = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`);
+        const originalPaths = await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')));
+        await page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME }).click();
+        await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 391, height: 900 });
+        await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).toEqual(originalPaths);
+        await page.clock.runFor(48);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).not.toEqual(originalPaths);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.clock.runFor(32);
+        const canvas = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`);
+        const dimensions = await canvas.evaluate((element: HTMLCanvasElement) => ({
+            width: element.width, expectedWidth: Math.round(element.getBoundingClientRect().width * devicePixelRatio),
+        }));
+        expect(dimensions.width).toBe(dimensions.expectedWidth);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.every((element) => !/NaN|Infinity/.test(element.getAttribute('d') ?? '')))).toBe(true);
+        await page.clock.resume();
+    }
+});

diff --git a/.tmp/capture-snake-before.mjs b/.tmp/capture-snake-before.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..0290e2bcb51472e2279b3d707a319e0d4471ceeb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/capture-snake-before.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import { chromium } from 'playwright';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+const DIRECTORY = '.tmp/snake-handoff/after';
+await mkdir(DIRECTORY, { recursive: true });
+const browser = await chromium.launch();
+const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
+page.on('pageerror', (error) => console.log(error.message));
+await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4010/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 180000 });
+const terrarium = page.locator('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]');
+await terrarium.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+await page.waitForFunction(() => {
+  const button = document.querySelector('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium] button');
+  return button && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+}, { timeout: 120000 });
+await page.clock.install();
+await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+const frame = await terrarium.boundingBox();
+await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/static.png`, clip: frame });
+await writeFile(`${DIRECTORY}/geometry.json`, JSON.stringify(await page.evaluate(() => {
+  const container = document.querySelector('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]');
+  const mark = container.querySelector('svg');
+  return { container: container.getBoundingClientRect(), mark: mark.getBoundingClientRect(), pixelRatio: devicePixelRatio };
+}), null, 2));
+await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Spustit minihru s krajtou' }).click();
+await page.locator('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium] canvas').waitFor();
+await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+await page.clock.runFor(17);
+await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/first.png`, clip: frame });
+for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 67, 100, 150, 200, 200, 300, 600, 1000]) {
+  await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+  await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/frame-${await page.evaluate(() => performance.now())}.png`, clip: frame });
+}
+await browser.close();
diff --git a/.tmp/inspect-snake-art.ts b/.tmp/inspect-snake-art.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4a5f3f624bd0e8b0045de75e3146656af4d216a1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/inspect-snake-art.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import { AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY, AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaMarkArtwork';
+import { createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaSnakeBody';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+async function main() {
+    const directory = '.tmp/snake-handoff/geometry';
+    await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
+    const shapes = createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY);
+    const pictures: Buffer[] = [];
+    for (const isCanonical of [true, false]) {
+        const markup = AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES.map((shape, index) => {
+            const gradient = shape.gradient;
+            const start = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x1, y: gradient.y1 } : shapes[index].gradientStart;
+            const end = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x2, y: gradient.y2 } : shapes[index].gradientEnd;
+            return `<defs><linearGradient id="${shape.id}" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="${start.x}" y1="${start.y}" x2="${end.x}" y2="${end.y}">${gradient.stops.map((stop) => `<stop offset="${stop.offset}" stop-color="${stop.color}"/>`).join('')}</linearGradient></defs><path d="${isCanonical ? shape.pathData : shapes[index].pathData}" fill="url(#${shape.id})"/>`;
+        }).join('');
+        const svg = Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 128 128" width="768" height="768"><rect width="128" height="128" fill="#232a25"/>${markup}</svg>`);
+        await sharp(svg).png().toFile(`${directory}/${isCanonical ? 'canonical' : 'deformed'}.png`);
+        pictures.push(await sharp(svg).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer());
+    }
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(pictures[0].length);
+    let maximum = 0;
+    let sum = 0;
+    const bounds = [Infinity, Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(pictures[0][offset + channel] - pictures[1][offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            maximum = Math.max(maximum, value);
+            sum += value;
+        }
+        if (pixelDifference > 2) {
+            const x = (offset / 4) % 768;
+            const y = Math.floor(offset / 4 / 768);
+            bounds[0] = Math.min(bounds[0], x); bounds[1] = Math.min(bounds[1], y);
+            bounds[2] = Math.max(bounds[2], x); bounds[3] = Math.max(bounds[3], y);
+        }
+        difference[offset] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 1] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 2] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+    }
+    await sharp(difference, { raw: { width: 768, height: 768, channels: 4 } }).png().toFile(`${directory}/difference.png`);
+    console.log({ maximum, mean: sum / difference.length, bounds });
+}
+main();

+    { name: 'mobile-1', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-2', width: 390, height: 900, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-3', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'small-mobile-3', width: 320, height: 800, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+] as const;
+
+async function preparePage(page: Page) {
+    await page.goto('/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+    await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+    // Freeze after hydration, so installing the controlled clock cannot prevent React from attaching activation.
+    await page.waitForFunction((selector) => {
+        const button = document.querySelector(`${selector} button`);
+        return button !== null && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+    await page.clock.install();
+    await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+    await page.addStyleTag({ content: `${TERRARIUM} output { visibility: hidden !important; }` });
+    await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+        const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+        (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark = mark;
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+}
+
+async function measureDifference(first: Buffer, second: Buffer) {
+    const reference = await sharp(first).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    const candidate = await sharp(second).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    expect(candidate.info).toEqual(reference.info);
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(reference.data.length);
+    let changedPixels = 0;
+    let maximumDifference = 0;
+    let differenceSum = 0;
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(reference.data[offset + channel] - candidate.data[offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            differenceSum += value;
+            difference[offset + channel] = Math.min(255, value * 12);
+        }
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+        if (pixelDifference > 0) changedPixels++;
+        maximumDifference = Math.max(maximumDifference, pixelDifference);
+    }
+    return {
+        changedPixels,
+        maximumDifference,
+        meanDifference: differenceSum / reference.data.length,
+        image: await sharp(difference, { raw: reference.info }).png().toBuffer(),
+        overlay: await sharp(first).composite([{ input: await sharp(second).ensureAlpha(0.5).png().toBuffer() }]).png().toBuffer(),
+    };
+}
+
+async function saveImage(testInfo: TestInfo, name: string, data: Buffer) {
+    await writeFile(testInfo.outputPath(name), data);
+    await testInfo.attach(name, { body: data, contentType: 'image/png' });
+}
+

+    test.describe(scenario.name, () => {
+        test.use({
+            viewport: { width: scenario.width, height: scenario.height },
+            deviceScaleFactor: scenario.pixelRatio,
+            hasTouch: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+            isMobile: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+        });
+
+        test('the original logo starts moving without a replacement shape', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
+            await preparePage(page);
+            const clip = (await page.locator(TERRARIUM).boundingBox())!;
+            const initialMarkup = await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML();
+            const frames: { name: string; image: Buffer }[] = [];
+            const capture = async (name: string) => {
+                const image = await page.screenshot({ clip });
+                frames.push({ name, image });
+                await saveImage(testInfo, `${name}.png`, image);
+                return image;
+            };
+            const staticFrame = await capture('00-static');
+            const button = page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME });
+            if (scenario.activation === 'touch') await button.tap();
+            else if (scenario.activation === 'click') await button.click();
+            else await button.press(scenario.activation);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+            await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+            const firstFrame = await capture('01-first-game');
+            const difference = await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstFrame);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-difference-12x.png', difference.image);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-overlay.png', difference.overlay);
+            expect(difference.changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).toBe(initialMarkup);
+
+            await page.clock.runFor(16);
+            const firstAnimationFrame = await capture('02-first-animation');
+            expect((await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstAnimationFrame)).changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            let elapsed = 0;
+            for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 188, 200, 600]) {
+                await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+                elapsed += duration;
+                await capture(`release-${String(elapsed).padStart(4, '0')}ms`);
+                expect(await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+                    const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+                    return mark === (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark &&
+                        getComputedStyle(mark).opacity === '1' && mark.querySelectorAll('path').length === 3;
+                }, TERRARIUM)).toBe(true);
+            }
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).not.toBe(initialMarkup);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} output`)).toContainText('Skóre:');
+
+            const contactSheet = await sharp({ create: { width: 280 * 4, height: 306 * 3, channels: 4, background: '#232a25' } })
+                .composite(await Promise.all(frames.map(async (frame, index) => ({
+                    input: await sharp(frame.image).resize(280, 280).extend({ bottom: 26, background: '#232a25' })
+                        .composite([{ input: Buffer.from(`<svg width="280" height="26"><text x="8" y="18" fill="white" font-size="13">${frame.name}</text></svg>`), top: 280, left: 0 }]).png().toBuffer(),
+                    left: (index % 4) * 280, top: Math.floor(index / 4) * 306,
+                }))))
+                .png().toBuffer();
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'release-contact-sheet.png', contactSheet);
+            const archive = path.resolve('.tmp/snake-handoff/verified', scenario.name);
+            await mkdir(archive, { recursive: true });
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'release-contact-sheet.png'), contactSheet);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'handoff-difference-12x.png'), difference.image);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'metrics.json'), JSON.stringify({
+                scenario, changedPixels: difference.changedPixels, maximumDifference: difference.maximumDifference,
+                meanDifference: difference.meanDifference, elapsed,
+            }, null, 2));
+        });
+    });
+}
+
+test('resize and another visit retain the logo and running path', async ({ page }) => {
+    for (let visit = 0; visit < 2; visit++) {
+        await preparePage(page);
+        const mark = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`);
+        const originalPaths = await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')));
+        await page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME }).click();
+        await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 391, height: 900 });

+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).toEqual(originalPaths);

+        }));
+        expect(dimensions.width).toBe(dimensions.expectedWidth);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.every((element) => !/NaN|Infinity/.test(element.getAttribute('d') ?? '')))).toBe(true);

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..4a5f3f624bd0e8b0045de75e3146656af4d216a1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/inspect-snake-art.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import { AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY, AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaMarkArtwork';
+import { createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork } from '../businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaSnakeBody';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+async function main() {
+    const directory = '.tmp/snake-handoff/geometry';
+    await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
+    const shapes = createAiTaKrajtaSnakeArtwork(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_BODY);
+    const pictures: Buffer[] = [];
+    for (const isCanonical of [true, false]) {
+        const markup = AI_TA_KRAJTA_MARK_SHAPES.map((shape, index) => {
+            const gradient = shape.gradient;
+            const start = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x1, y: gradient.y1 } : shapes[index].gradientStart;
+            const end = isCanonical ? { x: gradient.x2, y: gradient.y2 } : shapes[index].gradientEnd;
+            return `<defs><linearGradient id="${shape.id}" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="${start.x}" y1="${start.y}" x2="${end.x}" y2="${end.y}">${gradient.stops.map((stop) => `<stop offset="${stop.offset}" stop-color="${stop.color}"/>`).join('')}</linearGradient></defs><path d="${isCanonical ? shape.pathData : shapes[index].pathData}" fill="url(#${shape.id})"/>`;
+        }).join('');
+        const svg = Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 128 128" width="768" height="768"><rect width="128" height="128" fill="#232a25"/>${markup}</svg>`);
+        await sharp(svg).png().toFile(`${directory}/${isCanonical ? 'canonical' : 'deformed'}.png`);
+        pictures.push(await sharp(svg).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer());
+    }
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(pictures[0].length);
+    let maximum = 0;
+    let sum = 0;
+    const bounds = [Infinity, Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(pictures[0][offset + channel] - pictures[1][offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            maximum = Math.max(maximum, value);
+            sum += value;
+        }
+        if (pixelDifference > 2) {
+            const x = (offset / 4) % 768;
+            const y = Math.floor(offset / 4 / 768);
+            bounds[0] = Math.min(bounds[0], x); bounds[1] = Math.min(bounds[1], y);
+            bounds[2] = Math.max(bounds[2], x); bounds[3] = Math.max(bounds[3], y);
+        }
+        difference[offset] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 1] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 2] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+    }
+    await sharp(difference, { raw: { width: 768, height: 768, channels: 4 } }).png().toFile(`${directory}/difference.png`);
+    console.log({ maximum, mean: sum / difference.length, bounds });
+}
+main();

@@ -0,0 +1,165 @@
+import { expect, test, type Page, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
+import sharp from 'sharp';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+const TERRARIUM = '[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]';
+const ACTIVATION_NAME = 'Spustit minihru s krajtou';
+const SCENARIOS = [
+    { name: 'desktop-1', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'desktop-1.25', width: 1279, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 1.25, activation: 'Enter' },
+    { name: 'desktop-2', width: 1440, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'Space' },
+    { name: 'desktop-3', width: 1280, height: 1000, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'click' },
+    { name: 'mobile-1', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 1, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-2', width: 390, height: 900, pixelRatio: 2, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'mobile-3', width: 375, height: 900, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+    { name: 'small-mobile-3', width: 320, height: 800, pixelRatio: 3, activation: 'touch' },
+] as const;
+
+async function preparePage(page: Page) {
+    await page.goto('/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+    await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+    await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+    // Freeze after hydration, so installing the controlled clock cannot prevent React from attaching activation.
+    await page.waitForFunction((selector) => {
+        const button = document.querySelector(`${selector} button`);
+        return button !== null && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+    await page.clock.install();
+    await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+    await page.addStyleTag({ content: `${TERRARIUM} output { visibility: hidden !important; }` });
+    await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+        const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+        (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark = mark;
+    }, TERRARIUM);
+}
+
+async function measureDifference(first: Buffer, second: Buffer) {
+    const reference = await sharp(first).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    const candidate = await sharp(second).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
+    expect(candidate.info).toEqual(reference.info);
+    const difference = Buffer.alloc(reference.data.length);
+    let changedPixels = 0;
+    let maximumDifference = 0;
+    let differenceSum = 0;
+    for (let offset = 0; offset < difference.length; offset += 4) {
+        let pixelDifference = 0;
+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(reference.data[offset + channel] - candidate.data[offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            differenceSum += value;
+            difference[offset + channel] = Math.min(255, value * 12);
+        }
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+        if (pixelDifference > 0) changedPixels++;
+        maximumDifference = Math.max(maximumDifference, pixelDifference);
+    }
+    return {
+        changedPixels,
+        maximumDifference,
+        meanDifference: differenceSum / reference.data.length,
+        image: await sharp(difference, { raw: reference.info }).png().toBuffer(),
+        overlay: await sharp(first).composite([{ input: await sharp(second).ensureAlpha(0.5).png().toBuffer() }]).png().toBuffer(),
+    };
+}
+
+async function saveImage(testInfo: TestInfo, name: string, data: Buffer) {
+    await writeFile(testInfo.outputPath(name), data);
+    await testInfo.attach(name, { body: data, contentType: 'image/png' });
+}
+
+for (const scenario of SCENARIOS) {
+    test.describe(scenario.name, () => {
+        test.use({
+            viewport: { width: scenario.width, height: scenario.height },
+            deviceScaleFactor: scenario.pixelRatio,
+            hasTouch: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+            isMobile: scenario.activation === 'touch',
+        });
+
+        test('the original logo starts moving without a replacement shape', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
+            await preparePage(page);
+            const clip = (await page.locator(TERRARIUM).boundingBox())!;
+            const initialMarkup = await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML();
+            const frames: { name: string; image: Buffer }[] = [];
+            const capture = async (name: string) => {
+                const image = await page.screenshot({ clip });
+                frames.push({ name, image });
+                await saveImage(testInfo, `${name}.png`, image);
+                return image;
+            };
+            const staticFrame = await capture('00-static');
+            const button = page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME });
+            if (scenario.activation === 'touch') await button.tap();
+            else if (scenario.activation === 'click') await button.click();
+            else await button.press(scenario.activation);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+            await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+            const firstFrame = await capture('01-first-game');
+            const difference = await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstFrame);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-difference-12x.png', difference.image);
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'handoff-overlay.png', difference.overlay);
+            expect(difference.changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).toBe(initialMarkup);
+
+            await page.clock.runFor(16);
+            const firstAnimationFrame = await capture('02-first-animation');
+            expect((await measureDifference(staticFrame, firstAnimationFrame)).changedPixels).toBe(0);
+            let elapsed = 0;
+            for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 188, 200, 600]) {
+                await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+                elapsed += duration;
+                await capture(`release-${String(elapsed).padStart(4, '0')}ms`);
+                expect(await page.evaluate((selector) => {
+                    const mark = document.querySelector(`${selector} svg`)!;
+                    return mark === (window as unknown as { snakeOriginalMark: Element }).snakeOriginalMark &&
+                        getComputedStyle(mark).opacity === '1' && mark.querySelectorAll('path').length === 3;
+                }, TERRARIUM)).toBe(true);
+            }
+            expect(await page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`).innerHTML()).not.toBe(initialMarkup);
+            await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} output`)).toContainText('Skóre:');
+
+            const contactSheet = await sharp({ create: { width: 280 * 4, height: 306 * 3, channels: 4, background: '#232a25' } })
+                .composite(await Promise.all(frames.map(async (frame, index) => ({
+                    input: await sharp(frame.image).resize(280, 280).extend({ bottom: 26, background: '#232a25' })
+                        .composite([{ input: Buffer.from(`<svg width="280" height="26"><text x="8" y="18" fill="white" font-size="13">${frame.name}</text></svg>`), top: 280, left: 0 }]).png().toBuffer(),
+                    left: (index % 4) * 280, top: Math.floor(index / 4) * 306,
+                }))))
+                .png().toBuffer();
+            await saveImage(testInfo, 'release-contact-sheet.png', contactSheet);
+            const archive = path.resolve('.tmp/snake-handoff/verified', scenario.name);
+            await mkdir(archive, { recursive: true });
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'release-contact-sheet.png'), contactSheet);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'handoff-difference-12x.png'), difference.image);
+            await writeFile(path.join(archive, 'metrics.json'), JSON.stringify({
+                scenario, changedPixels: difference.changedPixels, maximumDifference: difference.maximumDifference,
+                meanDifference: difference.meanDifference, elapsed,
+            }, null, 2));
+        });
+    });
+}
+
+test('resize and another visit retain the logo and running path', async ({ page }) => {
+    for (let visit = 0; visit < 2; visit++) {
+        await preparePage(page);
+        const mark = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} svg`);
+        const originalPaths = await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')));
+        await page.getByRole('button', { name: ACTIVATION_NAME }).click();
+        await expect(page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`)).toBeVisible();
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 391, height: 900 });
+        await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).toEqual(originalPaths);
+        await page.clock.runFor(48);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.map((element) => element.getAttribute('d')))).not.toEqual(originalPaths);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 });
+        await page.locator(TERRARIUM).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+        await page.clock.runFor(32);
+        const canvas = page.locator(`${TERRARIUM} canvas`);
+        const dimensions = await canvas.evaluate((element: HTMLCanvasElement) => ({
+            width: element.width, expectedWidth: Math.round(element.getBoundingClientRect().width * devicePixelRatio),
+        }));
+        expect(dimensions.width).toBe(dimensions.expectedWidth);
+        expect(await mark.locator('path').evaluateAll((paths) => paths.every((element) => !/NaN|Infinity/.test(element.getAttribute('d') ?? '')))).toBe(true);
+        await page.clock.resume();
+    }
+});

+import { chromium } from 'playwright';
+import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+const DIRECTORY = '.tmp/snake-handoff/after';

+const browser = await chromium.launch();
+const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1000 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 });
+page.on('pageerror', (error) => console.log(error.message));
+await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4010/ai-ta-krajta', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 180000 });
+const terrarium = page.locator('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]');
+await terrarium.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
+await page.waitForFunction(() => {
+  const button = document.querySelector('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium] button');
+  return button && Object.keys(button).some((key) => key.startsWith('__reactProps'));
+}, { timeout: 120000 });
+await page.clock.install();
+await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date(Date.now() + 100));
+const frame = await terrarium.boundingBox();
+await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/static.png`, clip: frame });
+await writeFile(`${DIRECTORY}/geometry.json`, JSON.stringify(await page.evaluate(() => {
+  const container = document.querySelector('[data-ai-ta-krajta-terrarium]');
+  const mark = container.querySelector('svg');
+  return { container: container.getBoundingClientRect(), mark: mark.getBoundingClientRect(), pixelRatio: devicePixelRatio };
+}), null, 2));
+await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Spustit minihru s krajtou' }).click();

+await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+await page.clock.runFor(17);

+for (const duration of [16, 16, 32, 67, 100, 150, 200, 200, 300, 600, 1000]) {
+  await page.clock.runFor(duration);
+  await page.screenshot({ path: `${DIRECTORY}/frame-${await page.evaluate(() => performance.now())}.png`, clip: frame });
+}
+await browser.close();

+        for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel++) {
+            const value = Math.abs(pictures[0][offset + channel] - pictures[1][offset + channel]);
+            pixelDifference = Math.max(pixelDifference, value);
+            maximum = Math.max(maximum, value);
+            sum += value;
+        }
+        if (pixelDifference > 2) {
+            const x = (offset / 4) % 768;
+            const y = Math.floor(offset / 4 / 768);
+            bounds[0] = Math.min(bounds[0], x); bounds[1] = Math.min(bounds[1], y);
+            bounds[2] = Math.max(bounds[2], x); bounds[3] = Math.max(bounds[3], y);
+        }
+        difference[offset] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 1] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 2] = pixelDifference * 12;
+        difference[offset + 3] = 255;
+    }
+    await sharp(difference, { raw: { width: 768, height: 768, channels: 4 } }).png().toFile(`${directory}/difference.png`);
+    console.log({ maximum, mean: sum / difference.length, bounds });
+}
+main();
