diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

diff --git a/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..39f70b421f8c3c9ac4a0e4b5eb0deb93e5f9f3e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/verification-retry/handoff-review.md
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# Handoff review
+
+The original implementation drew a second snake from round canvas strokes while fading the canonical mark over it.
+The sampled body widths and colors could approximate the logo but could not reproduce its asymmetric head, coil,
+tail, or exact filled outline. A hold followed by the release crossfade postponed that visible replacement.
+The original placement also measured from the terrarium border rather than the canvas origin and treated the SVG
+frame as if it could stretch independently on both axes.
+
+The current implementation retains the original SVG element, view box, path artwork, gradients, shadow, and CSS
+frame. Its three canonical path strings and gradient stops are unchanged. The measured body drives exact cubic
+subdivisions of those fills; it is not drawn as another silhouette. Mesh patches prevent winding cancellation when
+the original coil folds. The hidden tail connection and the underside of the coil follow their respective sections.
+The deformation depends on displacement and growth, never on release time. Only speed, eyes, and food ease in.
+
+Canvas measures against the SVG in CSS coordinates, uses the actual device pixel ratio, and paints only food. The
+shared forward/inverse artwork transforms implement the SVG's centered aspect-ratio fit. The blank canvas exists
+before activation so mounting a new composited surface cannot disturb fractional-pixel placement at the handoff.
+Responsive resizing transforms the whole outline and preserves the travelled tail; changing just the SVG frame is
+handled independently of the field size. Wall/corner movement still uses the recorded contact vertices.
+
+The supplied failed traces show the header playback click preceding React initialization on both attempts. The
+newest-episode buttons now use the existing playback-initialization state, and snake activation becomes enabled
+after its client initializes. A browser regression deliberately delays script delivery, checks the disabled server
+controls, then verifies that the first enabled playback click opens the player.
+
+The repeat-visit capture used host time plus 100 milliseconds as its browser pause target. The controlled browser
+clock can be ahead after advancing a game, and a busy machine can also miss that small deadline. Each visit now
+resets the clock to a fixed start before pausing at a fixed later time. It waits for the public enabled state instead
+of React's private properties. Image overlays now replace existing alpha with 50% alpha rather than retaining an
+opaque screenshot.
+
+Focused verification: all 37 artwork, deformation, placement, simulation, and wall/corner tests passed. The delayed
+script playback check and the reported recording-studio navigation test passed without retries. After one cold
+development-script initialization failure, the repeat-visit resize check passed twice without retries. The exact
+required full command is recorded in `full-verification.log` in this directory.
+
+The capture matrix covers 320–1440 CSS-pixel viewports and device pixel ratios 1, 1.25, 2, and 3, with click, touch,
+Enter, and Space activation. Each sequence includes static, first game, first animation, and moving release frames
+through 1500 milliseconds, with aligned image differences and true half-opacity overlays. The full suite also checks
+the locally mapped canonical domain, independent SVG frame resizing, non-square aspect ratio, repeat visits,
+steering, food, and scoring. Captures and metrics are under `../snake-handoff/verified/`.
